# Perceptyx Sub-Processors ## Sub-Processors Posted August 7, 2026 - Effective as of September 6 Perceptyx uses certain sub-processors to assist in providing Perceptyx services. A sub-processor is a third party data processor engaged by Perceptyx who agrees to receive personal data from Perceptyx intended for processing activities necessary to support delivery of services. Perceptyx performs due diligence on the technical and organizational security measures of all sub-processors and requires each to commit to obligations regarding their security controls and applicable regulations for the protection of personal data. The table below shows information for each sub-processor including the sub-processing activity, the company’s location of processing, the services in which the sub-processor is used and the lawful transfer mechanism. In addition to our contractual obligations to our customers, the data controllers, Perceptyx has its own responsibilities under data privacy legislation as a data processor. If we fail to meet our obligations, or act outside of or against the data controller’s instructions, we may be liable for damages in legal proceedings, or be subject to fines or other penalties or corrective measures. As a data processor, we engage sub-processor services in accordance with our customers’ general written authorization. Perceptyx enters into agreements with each subprocessor, including Data Privacy Agreements (DPAs) and Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) as applicable. We remain liable to our customers for the compliance of any sub-processors we engage. ### How does Perceptyx select Sub-processors to support our service? In selecting a new sub-processor, Perceptyx conducts an extensive vetting process to meet our strategic goals and values. All sub-processors appointed by Perceptyx must meet the same controls we have committed to in our customer contracts and must comply with applicable data privacy laws. ### When does Perceptyx communicate about sub-processors? Perceptyx and the customer agree to the authorized list of sub-processors when a new customer signs their agreement. Perceptyx also provides notice via email when a sub-processor is added or changed, with an opportunity to object. ### We have no objections. Do we need to make any changes to our agreements? No. If a customer does not object within the 30-day window, approval of the sub-processor is implied and no further action is needed. If individual customers object or have immediate contract requirements, please reach out to your [privacy@perceptyx.com](mailto:privacy@perceptyx.com) for support. ### Objecting to A Sub-Processor Please submit your objection via [this LINK](https://go.perceptyx.com/sub-processor-objection).
